page.title: Build learning with a clear purpose.
page.description: Create, review, publish, and maintain the courses candidates and recruiters see in their learning workspace.

stats.activeCaption: At least one lesson done, not yet completed

notice.unpublished: Unpublished “{{title}}”. Learners who enrolled keep access.

empty.title: No courses match your filters
empty.text: Try a different search or choose All statuses.

builder.newDescription: Start with a title. The course stays a draft until you publish it.
builder.description: Edit the learner-facing details, lessons and final quiz, then preview and publish.
builder.locked: Learners are enrolled, so lessons and the quiz are locked. Copy and prices can still change.
builder.problemsText_one: {{count}} thing to finish before this course can go live.

new.formText: Give the course a clear title learners will recognise. Everything else is added in the builder.
new.titleHint: You can change it any time in Details.
new.draftNote: Drafts are only visible to admins.

steps.title: Name the course and create the draft.
steps.details: Category, level, summary, outcomes, cover and price.
steps.lessons: Video, text, PDF or link lessons, in order.
steps.quiz: The final quiz and its pass mark.
steps.preview: Check it as learners will see it, then publish.

details.euroHint: One-time price, VAT included. The other 7 currencies are converted from it.
details.convertedAt: Converted at the ECB rate of {{date}}, rounded to local price points.
details.convertedManual: Set by hand. A new euro price converts the others at today’s ECB rate.

autosave.error: Not saved. Check the fields marked in red.

details.pageText: Everything learners see before they enrol. The preview updates as you type.
details.title: Course title
details.categoryHint: Shown on cards, for example Interaction Design.
details.pipelineHint: Suggested to recruiters with active applications at this stage.
details.skillTagsHint: Separate with commas. Suggested to candidates missing these skills.
details.priceHint: One-time price in every currency, VAT included. All 8 are needed to publish a paid course.

lessons.emptyText: Add a video, text, PDF or link lesson. A course needs at least one lesson to publish.
lessons.title: Lesson title
lessons.unplayable: This browser cannot play the video. Check the file before publishing.
lessons.markdownHint: Headings, lists and https links. Anything unsafe is removed.
lessons.durationVideoHint: Read from the video when it uploads. You can change it.
lessons.durationHint: Optional. Counts toward the course length.

quiz.passMarkHint: Learners pass at this score or higher.
quiz.question: Question {{number}}

skillTags.required: Add at least one skill tag.

problems.prices: Add the {{currencies}} prices, or make the course free.

quiz.required: Add at least one quiz question.
